quotes.author: Cindy Powell
quotes.text: Our Nature group which is part of the Comox Valley Photographic Society just did a tour with Duncan and his crew. It was great to tailor the trip around what our interests were ( birds and sea mammals) Although we missed the herring spawn we still had beautiful weather and lots of sea lions. From a photographers point of view the boat was great as there are lots of viewing spots on the boat so everyone isn't fighting for a good vantage point. Thanks again Duncan and crew.

quotes.author: Adel Janssen
quotes.text: We recently took a charter with Comox Harbour Charters and it was the most perfect day for our family. Duncan and Clive are the best. They were so accommodating and made our trip to spread ashes extra special. The Twee Schoenen is a great boat for charters as it can go right into the shores of a beach which we did. It was the most perfect day. I highly recommend taking a charter with Duncan it will be a great memory. We will definitely be doing a day trip again.

quotes.author: Honey Rider
quotes.text: We chose Comox Harbour Charters to take our family to place our parents’ ashes in an area of the inside passage they had loved and visited many times over 30 years. Duncan and Larissa made our experience personal and meaningful. I would recommend them both to anyone looking a safe and relaxing experience for what ever reason you find yourself on the water.

quotes.author: E M
quotes.text: Duncan and Larissa did a great job chartering our family to spread ashes. Very respectful and professional. thanks. the McCartney's

quotes.author: James
quotes.text: Lovely people, stable boat, enthusiastic crew and helped us find lots birds for a survey. Would recommend
